# Office of Justice Programs

> > The Office of Justice Programs (OJP) advances evidence-based criminal justice research, policy, and practice through the National Institute of Justice and partner agencies.

OJP provides leadership and resources to improve the criminal justice system through research, data-driven programs, and partnerships with law enforcement agencies, researchers, and community organizations. The Justice Today Podcast and initiatives like the LEADS Scholars Program translate research findings into actionable strategies for practitioners.

## Key Topics

- Office of Justice Programs (OJP)
- National Institute of Justice (NIJ)
- Evidence-based policing
- Research-to-practice translation
- Law Enforcement Advancing Data and Science (LEADS) Scholars Program
- Criminal justice research
- Justice Today Podcast
- Center for Evidence-Based Crime Policy
- Evidence-to-action frameworks
- Law enforcement partnerships
- Data-driven policing
- NIJ National Research Conference
- Community safety initiatives
- Crime policy research

## Podcasts and Media

- [Progressing from Evidence to Action](https://ojp.gov/news/podcast/progessing-from-evidence-to-action): NIJ podcast on translating research to practice with law enforcement leaders
